ayahs.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast
ayahs.e2: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.en: And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.e2: which weighed so heavily on your back

ayahs.en: And raised high for you your repute
ayahs.e2: and elevated your renown for you

ayahs.en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease
ayahs.e2: So, surely with hardship comes ease

ayahs.en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]
ayahs.e2: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺

ayahs.en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing
ayahs.e2: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope
